Title: Deleting a catalog property used as a barcode field leaves scans failing until the setup is resaved
Preconditions:
Admin credentials {{ADMIN}}/{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}} available. This case DELETES @td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.propertyId) — the disposable property (value @td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.value) on product @td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.sku)) — to prove the reverse edge (RE1, 1c/3x). It must NOT delete @td(BARCODE_PROP.propertyId): that property is part of the configured field set other barcode cases (GraphQL and storefront suites) rely on, so deleting it would strand them.
Event-based indexation is OFF on vcst-qa, so after the delete this case requests a manual reindex of @td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.id) itself (POST /api/search/indexes/index) and polls before asserting the 0 result, re-requesting the reindex once more if the first request no-ops because another indexation held the lock.
Serialise with SRCHA-053 and SRCHA-054 (same disposable property) and with any other case that writes @td(BARCODE_STORE.id)'s barcode settings — the earlier constraint against running concurrently with a BARCODE_PROP (any field) case no longer applies, since this case never touches BARCODE_PROP.
Steps:
--- SCREEN: Fixture Setup (REST) ---
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token grant_type=password username={{ADMIN}} password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}} scope=offline_access — capture admin access_token
[HTTP] PUT {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/barcode-search/store/{{store}} Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token> body: {"scannerEnabled": true, "fields": ["{{ghost}}"]}
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql query: products(storeId: "{{store}}", currencyCode: "{{CURRENCY_CODE}}", filter: "category.subtree:@td(VIRTUAL_CATALOG_B2B.id) price.{{CURRENCY_CODE}}:(0 TO) barcode:'@td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.value)'") returning totalCount, Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token> — confirm totalCount=1 before deleting anything
[HTTP] DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/catalog/properties/@td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.propertyId) Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token>
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token> body: [{"documentType": "Product", "documentIds": ["@td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.id)"]}]
[WAIT] up to 90s for the reindex job to finish
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql query: products(storeId: "{{store}}", currencyCode: "{{CURRENCY_CODE}}", filter: "category.subtree:@td(VIRTUAL_CATALOG_B2B.id) price.{{CURRENCY_CODE}}:(0 TO) barcode:'@td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.value)'") returning totalCount, Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token>
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/search/indexes/index Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token> body: [{"documentType": "Product", "documentIds": ["@td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.id)"]}] — re-request only if the previous query still reported totalCount=1 (another indexation held the lock at the first request)
[WAIT] up to 90s for this second reindex request to finish, only if it was sent
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/graphql query: products(storeId: "{{store}}", currencyCode: "{{CURRENCY_CODE}}", filter: "category.subtree:@td(VIRTUAL_CATALOG_B2B.id) price.{{CURRENCY_CODE}}:(0 TO) barcode:'@td(BARCODE_STALE_FIELD.value)'") returning totalCount, Authorization: Bearer <admin access_token> — this is the value asserted
